description: Every device permission decision on the phone, oldest first, on Android and iOS: when an app was granted or denied a permission (by install, import, update or the Settings switch), when a permission was removed, and each time an app action used a permission or was blocked by a denial, with the assistant that called it. Filter by app, permission or event. Changes nothing.
